author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV and portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portofolio). Open until positions are filled.

author: willai3213
title: Exhibition seeking designer for character visuals
content: Looking for a graphic/illustration collaborator for a December exhibition at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visual design (6 characters, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, flags, and other exhibition derivatives. Timeline: early October first drafts, mid-November print-ready. Seeking hand-drawn, Japanese-inspired, warm style. Comment or DM with portfolio and quote.
